sourceFile: 55. BRS-161016 Report test using SUB BAFFLE JIG BAKO V1, RUBER GASKET, GS 0.65T, YS 10.0-7.5-0.4T improve 9.8.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but misgroups separate YS thickness/test contexts and contains an incorrect E2 baseline comparison.
issues: Combines 0.4T and 0.45T sheets under one changed factor without subgroup separation.
Changed factor is the full condition bundle, not only Normal vs Test new JIG.
E2 test row is compared to C2 normal row; should use E2 normal row.
Outcome judgement is distorted by the wrong E2 pairing.
Measurement outcome appears unsupported by cited table header/stat extraction.
correctionPlan: Split or explicitly subgroup by sheet, YS thickness, date, line, and test scope.
Rename changed factor to the tested condition bundle versus normal process.
Recalculate E2 using its matching normal row and update effect direction.
Keep C2 0.45T, E2 0.45T, and 0.4T C2 results as separate subresults.
Remove unsupported measurement statistics or recast them as function defect category counts only.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but current citations are insufficient because key comparison grouping is wrong.
